verdict.rationale: Rive has an in-editor AI agent that works on the user's file and generates scripts, responsive layouts, data models, and animation. MCP tooling also lets AI build View Models and State Machines. That is AI generation and task automation inside the product, not AI that analyzes the user's data and offers insights or recommendations. Missing for 10: any evidence of AI-generated insights or analysis of user/file data, proactive suggestions or recommendations, documentation of how the agent reasons over existing content, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
